goals: Keep canonical full leaves entirely provider-owned while making BGE-derived leaf geometry visibly bushy through provider-neutral, additive foliage.
Use BGE canonical bindings and exact exposed SurfacePatch geometry as the sole authority for material identity, resolved topology, and decorative attachment footprint.
Sample active final canonical leaf appearance after public Fabric model wrapping, without resource-path, registry-name, or provider-specific conventions.
scope: Canary 3 captures each canonical-root leaf BlockStateModel after ModelModifier.WRAP_LAST_PHASE, retains the clean BGE base model, and appends authored two-sided slanted cards only over merged binding-owned surface patches.

The cards preserve the sampled canonical quad's atlas/sprite, tint, render layer, UV, emissive, light, and shading behavior through public FRAPI quad accessors before changing authored positions and normals; non-cull samples are preferred and ordinary canonical leaf quads are the fallback.

The generic path covers BGE horizontal Slabs, resolved Stairs and Walls, Vertical Slabs, Steps, Layers, Corners, and Quarter Columns; a centralized small-support rule scales or omits a motif without geometry-name branches.

exclusions: BGE remains unchanged and owns canonical material identity plus resolved SurfacePatch topology; BGE × CTM remains optional adjacent context, not a dependency or geometry authority.
No bushy-leaf resource-pack, mod, texture, model JSON, shader, provider class, or asset is copied, redistributed, or modified. The protected Minecraft testing profiles are not inspected or changed.

Inventory, hand, creative-menu, JEI, collision, outline, placement, drops, recipes, waterlogging, leaf distance/persistence/decay, rain drip, redstone, pathfinding, and BGE family membership remain untouched.
No registry-name inference, per-geometry ID list, Stair/Wall special branch, guessed cube halo, broad same-leaf decorative culling, or gameplay-state mutation is permitted.

dependencies.reason: C78 is the oldest demonstrated BGE capability that supplies authoritative resolved patches for every requested topology; C84 is the controlled C3 compile baseline.
Canary 3 targets Minecraft Java 26.2 public block-model and renderer-quad interfaces.
Provides the public model-loading and renderer APIs used by the client-only C3 wrapper.

dependencies.requirement: optional; sampled at client resource reload
dependencies.reason: Owner runtime evidence confirms Foundation v2 visibly supplies the active full-block bushy leaves in the real stack. C3 samples whichever final canonical baked leaf appearance is active and does not package or depend on Foundation, Matcha, or another provider's resource path.
Minecraft 26.2 and the controlled build use Java 25.

state.milestone: Canary 3 is the current client-only additive-rendering artifact: it keeps the Matcha-style patch-local crossed/slanted foliage cards and their BGE SurfacePatch placement, but transfers captured canonical appearance through public FRAPI accessors rather than a cross-renderer bulk quad copy. Exact C2 bge-bushy-leaves-0.2.0-canary2.jar SHA-256 728bb10952642edb37f1c22e9a5514bf1499e4b2c7f97024c09ee88a9c1596eb is RUNTIME_FAIL: the owner supplied a chunk-mesh-build NullPointerException at Sodium MutableQuadViewImpl.copyFrom via PatchLocalFoliage.emitCard. Exact C1 bge-bushy-leaves-0.1.0-canary1.jar SHA-256 e85262f792638e99b5c1fdac9c48043e5bb461da55ce9a50fbc07cc1a24f7fbf remains RUNTIME_FAIL/no-op. C3 has controlled validation only and remains RUNTIME_UNTESTED.

exceptions.reason: Canary 3 uses Minecraft 26.2's public final model and Fabric renderer-quad seams while consuming BGE's capability-owned surface contract rather than a BGE release-name check.
regression_evidence: Java 25 / Gradle 9.5.1 / Fabric Loom 1.17.19 --rerun-tasks check and staged JAR build against BGE C84 SHA-256 9c3a7af8eb86ffabcf5ddc3c7ba96134fb4322c6b92c3530dc8788edac015759 produced bge-bushy-leaves-0.2.1-canary3.jar, 31,933 bytes, SHA-256 e68097eb0199778ef2cb99adac1c83df85aa012c835667bc97fd77582fb8214a from implementation checkpoint a153a158e096d04393712a4b80d859be03656e84.

Twenty focused synthetic/unit tests passed, including a captured-QuadView-to-renderer-owned-QuadEmitter regression that rejects bulk copyFrom and asserts explicit public FRAPI transfer of atlas, layer, item type, emissive/AO/shading/animation metadata, tint/tag, UVs, colors, lightmaps, normals, nominal face, and no cull face; existing semantic, appearance, reload, deterministic patch-local, and BGE geometry fixtures also passed.

Controlled verification passed BGE API and Fabric renderer/model-loader hash gates, JAR metadata and required-class checks, and provider-asset exclusion checks; it is not Minecraft visual/runtime evidence.

current.summary: Fixes Sodium/FRAPI chunk-mesh crashes by transferring canonical quad appearance through public accessors while retaining deterministic patch-local foliage geometry.
